body: From the DM-172 review (orchestrator, this run): wire `projectRunTiming` (src/core/services/timing.ts). Under the one `current_plan` sprint rule a past sprint's numbers change retroactively after an adoption moves a ticket, and a sprint can show effort before it is activated (`elapsed` missing); frozen report snapshots must capture timing at the cutoff rather than recompute later. A ticket moved to a later sprint loses readiness and later raises `event_out_of_place` (services/timing.ts:288-294, space/timing.ts:564-567): take readiness from the sprint that held the ticket at first claim. The heartbeat fallback for imported resubmitted expired attempts is reported as plain `observed` (services/timing.ts:179-181): mark it estimated or anomalous.
